```{r}
# =========================================================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(GO.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(ggplot2)

citation("vegan")

# =========================================================
# LOAD eggNOG ANNOTATIONS
# =========================================================
annotations <- read.delim(
  "Spez_eggnog.emapper.annotations",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  comment.char = "#"
)

colnames(annotations) <- c(
  "query_name","seed_ortholog","evalue","score",
  "eggNOG_OGs","max_annot_lvl","COG_category",
  "Description","Preferred_name","GOs",
  "EC","KEGG_ko","KEGG_pathway","KEGG_module",
  "KEGG_reaction","KEGG_rclass","BRITE",
  "KEGG_TC","CAZy","BiGG_Reaction","PFAMs"
)

# =========================================================
# CLEAN GO TERMS
# =========================================================
annot_clean <- annotations %>%
  mutate(query_name = str_replace(query_name, "\\.t\\d+$", "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GOs), GOs != "-") %>%
  mutate(GOs = str_replace_all(GOs, "\\s+", "")) %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(GO = str_extract(GOs, "GO:\\d{7}")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GO)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene = query_name, GO) %>%
  distinct()

# =========================================================
# TERM2GENE
# =========================================================
TERM2GENE <- annot_clean %>%
  filter(grepl("^GO:\\d{7}$", GO)) %>%
  distinct(GO, gene)

# =========================================================
# TERM2NAME
# =========================================================
TERM2NAME <- TERM2GENE %>%
  distinct(GO) %>%
  mutate(termName = AnnotationDbi::Term(GO)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(termName)) %>%
  rename(term = GO)

# =========================================================
# ADD ONTOLOGY
# =========================================================
go_ont <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(TERM2NAME$term),
  columns = "ONTOLOGY",
  keytype = "GOID"
)

TERM2NAME2 <- TERM2NAME %>%
  left_join(go_ont, by = c("term" = "GOID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ONTOLOGY)) %>%
  mutate(ONTOLOGY = factor(ONTOLOGY, levels = c("BP", "CC", "MF")))

# =========================================================
# GENE LIST
# =========================================================
geneList <- res_df_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, log2FoldChange) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  distinct()

geneList <- setNames(geneList$log2FoldChange, geneList$Gene)
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

```


# Gut

# GO term slimming
```{r}
# =========================================================
# 1. BACKGROUND GENES
# =========================================================
background_genes <- unique(
  str_replace(TERM2GENE$gene, "\\.t\\d+$", "")
)

# =========================================================
# 2. DEG GENES
# =========================================================
deg_genes_gut <- res_df_clean %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  str_replace("\\.t\\d+$", "") %>%
  intersect(background_genes)

up_genes <- res_df_clean %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  str_replace("\\.t\\d+$", "") %>%
  intersect(background_genes)

down_genes <- res_df_clean %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  str_replace("\\.t\\d+$", "") %>%
  intersect(background_genes)

go_up <- enricher(
  gene = up_genes,
  universe = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

go_down <- enricher(
  gene = down_genes,
  universe = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

revigo_up <- as.data.frame(go_up) %>%
  transmute(
    GO_ID = ID,
    value = -log10(p.adjust)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(value))

revigo_down <- as.data.frame(go_down) %>%
  transmute(
    GO_ID = ID,
    value = -log10(p.adjust)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(value))


write.table(
  revigo_up,
  "Revigo_input/revigo_gut_up.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  revigo_down,
  "Revigo_input/revigo_gut_down.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)
```

# Read in REVIGO collapsed GO term lists
```{r}
revigo_up <- read.delim("Revigo_output/Revigo_BP_gut_up.tsv")
revigo_down <- read.delim("Revigo_output/Revigo_BP_gut_down.tsv")
```


```{r}
deg_gene_df <- res_df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_replace(Gene, "\\.t\\d+$", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    padj < 0.05,
    !is.na(log2FoldChange)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    ID = Gene,
    logFC = log2FoldChange
  )
```

# Up
```{r}
# =========================================================
# GUT – UPREGULATED GO CIRCLE (REVIGO FILTERED)
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(GOplot)

# =========================================================
# 2. KEEP ONLY REVIGO TERMS
# =========================================================

ora_up <- as.data.frame(go_up) %>%
  filter(ID %in% revigo_up$TermID) %>%
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

# =========================================================
# 3. ADD ONTOLOGY
# =========================================================

ora_up <- ora_up %>%
  left_join(
    TERM2NAME2 %>%
      dplyr::select(term, ONTOLOGY),
    by = c("ID" = "term")
  )

# =========================================================
# KEEP REVIGO TERMS
# =========================================================

ora_up <- as.data.frame(go_up) %>%
  filter(ID %in% revigo_up$TermID) %>%
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

# =========================================================
# BUILD GENE LISTS FROM TERM2GENE
# =========================================================

go_terms_up <- TERM2GENE %>%
  filter(GO %in% ora_up$ID) %>%
  mutate(
    gene = str_replace(gene, "\\.t\\d+$", "")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    deg_gene_df,
    by = c("gene" = "ID")
  ) %>%
  group_by(GO) %>%
  summarise(
    genes = paste(unique(gene), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ora_up %>%
      dplyr::select(ID, Description, p.adjust),
    by = c("GO" = "ID")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    TERM2NAME2 %>%
      dplyr::select(term, ONTOLOGY),
    by = c("GO" = "term")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    category = ONTOLOGY,
    ID = GO,
    term = Description,
    genes = genes,
    adj_pval = p.adjust
  )

circ_up <- circle_dat(
  go_terms_up,
  deg_gene_df
)

Gut_GO_up <- GOCircle(
  circ_up,
  nsub = length(unique(circ_up$term)),
  lfc.col = c("#D4476C","#2C728E")
)

# For the scale, the z-scores
range(circ_up$zscore, na.rm = TRUE)

# Make it a ggplot
Gut_GO_up_gg <- as.ggplot(Gut_GO_up)
```

```{r}
lipid_genes <- TERM2GENE %>%
  filter(GO %in% lipid_go_terms) %>%
  distinct(gene)

nrow(lipid_genes)

lipid_annotations <- lipid_genes %>%
  left_join(
    annotations %>%
      mutate(query_name = str_replace(query_name, "\\.t\\d+$", "")),
    by = c("gene" = "query_name")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    Preferred_name,
    Description,
    EC,
    KEGG_ko
  ) %>%
  distinct()

lipid_deg <- lipid_genes %>%
  inner_join(
    res_df_clean %>%
      mutate(Gene = str_replace(Gene, "\\.t\\d+$", "")) %>%
      filter(
        padj < 0.05,
        !is.na(log2FoldChange)
      ),
    by = c("gene" = "Gene")
  )
nrow(lipid_deg)

library(DESeq2)

mat <- assay(vsd)

lipid_mat <- mat[
  rownames(mat) %in% lipid_deg$gene,
]

gene_labels <- lipid_annotations %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, Preferred_name) %>%
  distinct()

rownames(lipid_mat) <- gene_labels$Preferred_name[
  match(rownames(lipid_mat), gene_labels$gene)
]

View(lipid_mat)

lipid_mat_z <- t(scale(t(lipid_mat)))

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Site = metadata$condition
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(metadata)

ann_colors <- list(
  Site = c(
    "Reference" = "#2C728E",
    "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
  )
)

clean_labels <- sub(
  "^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*",
  "\\1",
  colnames(lipid_mat_z)
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(metadata)

z_score_colors <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#2e2eff", "#ffffff", "#ff0902")
)(100)

# symmetric scale around zero
max_abs <- max(abs(lipid_mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)

lipid_heatmap <-pheatmap(
  lipid_mat_z,
  color = z_score_colors,
  breaks = seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 101),
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  labels_col = clean_labels,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8
)

# Convert to ggplot
lipid_heatmap_gg <- as.ggplot(lipid_heatmap)

ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Lipid_Metabolism_Heatmap.svg",
  plot = lipid_heatmap_gg,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  units = "in"
)

```

```{r}
lipid_mat_collapsed <- lipid_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  mutate(Gene = gsub("\\..*$", "", Gene)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

lipid_mat_z_2 <- t(scale(t(lipid_mat_collapsed)))

max_abs_2 <- max(abs(lipid_mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)

lipid_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  lipid_mat_z_2,
  color = z_score_colors,
  breaks = seq(-max_abs_2, max_abs_2, length.out = 101),
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  labels_col = clean_labels,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8
)

lipid_heatmap_gg <- as.ggplot(lipid_heatmap)

ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Lipid_Metabolism_Heatmap.svg",
  plot = lipid_heatmap_gg,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
lipid_deg_table <- lipid_deg %>%

    gene,

    padj

  left_join(
    lipid_annotations,

lipid_deg_table

lipid_deg_table %>%
```
